results.detail: Main/preload/shared and renderer TypeScript projects passed no-emit checks.
3 test files; 28 tests passed, including scanner origin/reference/UID/limit cases and 5 controller generation-race cases.
1 portable Electron flow passed using the controlled fixture and an OS-temporary app-data profile; no owner path is required.
2 explicit evidence flows passed with STUDIO_OWNER_PROJECT, STUDIO_OWNER_APP_DATA, and STUDIO_EVIDENCE_ROOT supplied: corrected controlled fixture and Bakery Sort.
2 tests were explicitly skipped, proving the owner-specific evidence command is not a false portable requirement.

acceptanceAssertions: The portable suite selects and trusts only a controlled fixture through the visible Choose project flow.
Portable app data and Playwright output use temporary directories.
The trust modal receives focus, traps Tab and Shift+Tab, closes with Escape, and restores focus to the invoking control.
Owner notes expose and enforce their shared character limits.
Project source, tooling, generated output, and Godot-ignored content are visibly distinct.
Generated copies do not inflate source-level inventories or capability findings.
Only supported concrete dependency syntax produces confirmed missing-file warnings.
Only the current immutable scan generation may publish a terminal state.
UID-based main scenes remain unresolved limitations rather than missing-path warnings.
Studio, Project, and Builds remain the only primary areas.
The Builds view reports No builds recorded.
Whole-tree integrity is unchanged across the explicit Bakery Sort owner trial.
